takeaways: The strongest unused material is the Friend backyard renovation, split across B&A-Friend, Friend Residence Patio Project, Annuals-Spring and Annual Flowers-Residential: mud before, design plan and 3D renders, then summer, fall, snow and night-lit afters. It is ready-made for a before/after section on work/sylvan-gardens and the organic-social-growth-landscaping post. The best single stills are Photos JOBS 2023 #65 (stone steps through perennials), Friend Patio #23 (lit bluestone path), B&A-Friend #5 (whole-yard after) and the commercial mandevilla entry (#98). Any of them would make a better Sylvan cover than a flower close-up. The pro-shot crew set (Crew Pics #21/#24/#30) and the Decker modern plantings add polish and people to the case study. The July 2024 phone BTS shoots are mostly 2-3; only a few vertical clips (July 3 #97 seeder in dust, Landscape Lighting #15) are worth a look for hero-loop stacks.
